additional_concerns: Candidate node.11d4e8e1976eb5b2900022be has unavailable executable meaning. Its typed question cannot establish executable correspondence, and the unsupported '+' diagnostic does not identify a substantive legal defect.
Footnote 7 locates the holistic designation assessment below 50% of NAV. An operative designation input does not implement that assessment or turn its factors into automatic triggers.
Candidate node.241bdcebd49036f3d3ad3a42 delegates exposure measurement, LAF identification and designation verification to supplied judgments. Completeness of those judgments remains unassessed.
The dependency records have no identifying metadata or non-null source hashes. Missing authorities cannot reliably be assigned to those IDs.
Neither question establishes declassification after declining exposure. A false route result must not be treated as general non-complex status or permission to distribute.

The runtime conflict-blocking policy is an additional implementation restriction, not a requirement of the circular. Its legal fidelity is not established by source support for the classification rules.
The 15% direct-investment limit in footnote 1 is separate from complex-product classification. A classification result neither establishes compliance with that limit nor permits exceeding it.
